text:
Type: framed graphic flower print
Use: wall decoration above a sofa, sideboard or desk; living room, dining room, home office, hallway
Style: Scandinavian, mid-century modern, minimalist
Materials: printed artwork under clear glazing, slim black frame
Colors: white background, black, red, yellow
Shape: upright rectangle in a thin black frame, line drawing of tall seed-head flowers with thin stems and oval pods, sparse composition with lots of white space, light visual weight
Feel: playful, graphic, airy
Goes with: white walls, black accents, light wood, red or yellow touches; Scandinavian or mid-century modern rooms
